# Test fixtures

Constant input files for the data loader tests and scene snapshots. Changing a
file changes the expected scenes, so update the snapshots in the same commit.

| File | Format | Nodes | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|
| small.d3.json | d3 hierarchy JSON | small | hand-written |
| small.lang.json | language map | | hand-written, labels for small.d3.json |
| flare.csv | CSV (dot paths) | 252 | the Flare class hierarchy from the d3 examples |
| animals.skos.xml | SKOS | small | hand-written |
| primates.treeml.xml | TreeML | 192 | copy of the primates tree from hypertree-of-life, by the same author, released for this repo |
| primates.d3.json | d3 hierarchy JSON | 1128 | the primates of the Open Tree of Life synthesis 16.1 (depth 19), as the hypertree-of-life data pipeline writes it for its branch pages (fans pruned; per node `name`, `ottId`, `nodes`, `leafs`, `sitelinks`, `importance`, ...). Real names and a real shape for the playground; the Open Tree synthesis is CC0 |
| embryophyta.d3.json | d3 hierarchy JSON | 45740 | the land plants of the same source (depth 88, 4.2 MB): a large and deep real tree, for the filter, the deep-navigation cases and the performance comparisons |
| filesystem.d3.json | d3 hierarchy JSON | 10000 | made-up file system, generated by `node fixtures/gen-filesystem.mjs` (seeded, the same on every run); every node has `name`, `type` (dir / file), `size` (bytes, folders: sum), `files` and `dirs` below it. Heavy-tailed like a real disk: a few huge files (videos, disk images) hold most of the size, a few folders hold most of the files (node_modules, caches), some are both (raw photos). Preset `infovisFiles` |
